lines.t: Blessed is the soul who receives the call Who holds it close and gives it all
Not turning back, not standing still
But yielding fully to His will
A servant walks a narrow way
Lays down his life from day to day
He lifts the cross with steady hands
And follows where the Master stands
With every breath
Surrender grows
In quiet strength, devotion shows
Blessed is the one who answers
With the heart completely true
Open hands and spirit broken
Living only just for you
In the stillness of the morning
At your feet he chooses to stand
And your heart finds joy within
Held securely in your hands
The dawn he bows in reverence deep
Before the Lord his soul will keep
No pride remains, no claim to own
His life is not his own alone
With open heart and lifted eyes
He offers all, no compromise
Empty hands yet filled with grace
He seeks the light of your embrace
In silent trust his spirit bends
A faithful walk that never ends
Blessed is the one who answers
With the heart completely true
Open hands and spirit broken
Living only just for you
In the stillness of the morning
At your feet you choose to stand
And your heart finds joy within
And held securely in your hands
Not for glory, not for name
Not for honor or for fame
But simply drawn by holy fire
Consumed within a pure desire
To walk the path, to give his all
To rise again each time he falls
A life poured out, a vessel free
Becoming what he's called to be
Kneeling low, open soul
So, nothing helped, nothing withheld.
Blessed is the one who answers, who lays everything aside.
Taking up the cross before Him, with no shadow left to hide.
In the quiet you receive him
In the truth he stands refined
And your soul delights within him
Faithful, willing, heart aligned
Blessed is the one
Who chooses you
Again
And again
And again
